question: What is the primary purpose of international nursing organizations?

options.B: Giving nurses a unified voice on global health policies
options.C: Managing direct patient care in rural clinics
options.D: Setting local hospital budgets in every country

explanation: These organizations connect national groups to advocate together and share knowledge on a global scale. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h1)

question: Why do nurses around the world share a similar core mission, even though local laws differ?

options.A: All nursing schools use the same textbook worldwide
options.B: Every country follows identical governmental regulations
options.C: International bodies dictate exact daily hospital routines
options.D: Human health needs and caring for others are universal

explanation: You've got this! Basic patient needs and a heart to help others are the same no matter where you practice. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h1)

question: What is the International Council of Nurses (ICN)?

options.A: A large federation representing millions of nurses worldwide through their national associations
options.B: A government department that regulates global medicine prices
options.C: A global union that directly hires nurses for foreign hospitals
options.D: A funding agency that builds community clinics in developing nations

explanation: Think of the ICN as a massive team that unites nursing groups from over 130 countries together! [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h2)

question: In what year was the International Council of Nurses founded?
explanation: The ICN was established at the end of the nineteenth century to unite nurses globally. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h2)

question: Which document serves as the global moral compass and ethical guide for nursing?

options.B: The ICN Code of Ethics for Nurses
options.C: The World Health Organization budget report

explanation: The ICN Code of Ethics helps guide our daily professional decisions and keeps patient care safe and compassionate worldwide. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h3)

question: How do international standards help nursing students and practitioners?

options.A: They guarantee identical salaries for nurses in every country
options.B: They eliminate all cultural differences in healthcare delivery
options.C: They define core skills and ethical expectations for safe care
options.D: They replace the need for clinical experience in student training

explanation: Global standards give every student a clear baseline of the skills and values needed to provide safe care. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h3)

question: Why is fighting for nurse welfare by international bodies so important for patient safety?

options.A: International advocacy prevents patients from ever contracting chronic illnesses
options.B: Government officials only listen to foreign organizations regarding patient care
options.C: Higher salaries automatically eliminate all hospital equipment shortages
options.D: Exhausted and overworked nurses are more likely to make mistakes

explanation: When we take care of nurses' working conditions, we directly protect the patients they serve! [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h4)

question: Which of these is NOT something global workforce advocacy usually focuses on?

options.A: Fighting for fair pay and professional respect
options.B: Setting individual hospital room decoration policies
options.C: Promoting safe working environments free from violence
options.D: Developing leadership roles in health ministries

explanation: Room decorations are handled locally by each hospital. Advocacy is all about staffing, safety, pay, and leadership! [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h4)

question: Why is the partnership between international nursing bodies and the World Health Organization (WHO) so vital?

options.A: The WHO dictates the daily shift schedules of local nurses
options.B: Nurses make up the largest part of the global health workforce
options.C: Nurses hold legal authority to write international health treaties
options.D: The WHO relies entirely on nurses to fund its global operations

explanation: Since nurses are the heartbeat of healthcare and make up most of the workforce, global health goals cannot happen without us. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h5)

question: What major global health goal relies heavily on nurses working alongside the WHO?

options.A: Global unification of national tax systems
options.B: Complete eradication of all human disease

explanation: Making sure everyone can get healthcare (Universal Health Coverage) depends entirely on a strong, supported nursing team. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h5)

question: A Nigerian nurse wants to practice abroad. Why are international nursing standards helpful for her registration process?

options.A: They help ensure her local training and skills are respected globally
options.B: They eliminate the need to ever study foreign medical laws
options.C: They waive all immigration and visa fees for healthcare workers
options.D: They automatically grant her permanent citizenship in the destination country

explanation: Global standards make it easier for countries to recognize the hard work you put into your Nigerian nursing education! [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h6)

question: How does the Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria (NMCN) use international guidelines locally?

options.A: To set the prices of pharmaceutical drugs in local pharmacies
options.B: To replace national health laws with foreign legislation
options.C: To match local training and registration requirements with global standards
options.D: To take over the daily administration of every teaching hospital in Nigeria

explanation: The NMCN uses international frameworks to make sure Nigerian midwifery and nursing education stays top-notch worldwide. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T6#BMP110_U1_T6_h6)
